---
title: "Part 2 — Composing Hello Pico"
---

Part 2 walks through composing `hello-world-pico` into a runnable Kubernetes
workload with Crossplane: authoring a Composition, applying the Composite
Resource, and letting the Crossplane control plane reconcile the Managed
Resources that back the deployment.

## Lessons

Lesson content for Part 2 follows the same lesson layout as
[Part 1](../part-1/index.qmd) and the
[Pico Introduction lesson](../../pico/part-1/01-introduction/index.html).

::: {.callout-warning title="Scaffold — Part 2 not yet runnable"}
Part 2 is intentionally scaffolded so the Crossplane course demonstrates the
multi-part structure. It does **not** yet carry runnable learner content.
Use the [Hello Pico lab](../../../labs/hello-pico/) to produce the input
artifact, then track [Part 1](../part-1/index.qmd) for the first runnable
Crossplane lesson.
:::
